info.title: API.SH: Wattpad
info.description: The Wattpad API from API.SH: public Wattpad data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Wattpad's story categories (`id`, `name`, `local_name`, `roles`) and story languages (`id`, `code`, `name`, `native_name`, `locale`): the ids the other Wattpad routes take.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wattpad-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The hot stories of a Wattpad category, ranked (`rank`), in one language, with the category's tag facets. Each story: `id`, `title`, `url`, `description`, `cover`, `author`, `language`, `categories`, `tags`, `completed`, `mature`, `paywalled`, `parts_count`, `reads`, `votes`, `comments`, `length`, `created_at`, `modified_at` and `raw`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wattpad-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id from /wattpad/v1/categories, e.g. `4` (Romance), `3` (Fantasy), `6` (Fanfiction).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Story language: a code (`en`, `es`, `fr`, `id`, `tl`, `pt`, `de`, `tr`, `ar`...), a language name or a numeric id from /wattpad/v1/categories.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 30, max 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Comments on a Wattpad part (chapter), newest first, including the comments readers left on single paragraphs; or the replies to one comment. Each: `id`, `text`, `author`, `created_at`, `replies` (count), `on` (part, paragraph or comment), `paragraph_id`, `url` and `raw`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wattpad-comments

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: Part id (e.g. `1428326771`) or its link. Not needed when `comment` is given.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: A comment `id` from this route: lists that comment's replies instead.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 20, max 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stories on Wattpad (wattpad.com, reader-written fiction) for keywords and tags, with the filters of the site's search page: language, completed only, last update, paid or free, and part count. Each story: `id`, `title`, `url`, `description`, `cover`, `author`, `language`, `categories`, `tags`, `completed`, `mature`, `paywalled`, `parts_count`, `reads`, `votes`, `comments`, `length`, `created_at`, `modified_at` and `raw`. Also `total` and the tag and category facets (`tag_facets`, `category_facets`) with counts. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wattpad-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `vampire`. May include `#tag` words; or use `tags`.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags the stories must carry, comma separated (e.g. `werewolf,romance`).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Story language: a code (`en`, `es`, `fr`, `id`, `tl`, `pt`, `de`, `tr`, `ar`...), a language name or a numeric id from /wattpad/v1/categories.

parameters.name: completed
parameters.description: `true`: completed stories only.

parameters.name: updated_within
parameters.description: Last updated within a `day`, `week`, `month` or `year`.

parameters.name: paid
parameters.description: `true`: paid (Wattpad Originals) stories only; `false`: free stories only; default both.

parameters.name: min_parts
parameters.description: Least number of parts (chapters).

parameters.name: max_parts
parameters.description: Most number of parts (chapters).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 30, max 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
